Generate the authorization profile in PFCG after that authorization data is complete, because the generated profile is what the user buffer checks. Assign the role on the PFCG User tab or in transaction SU01, then run user comparison so the profile enters the user buffer. Review table AGR_USERS for the user assignment and table AGR_1251 for authorization values, and do not treat AGR_USERS as a transaction. Transport the released role change with the Change and Transport System and import it in the target system. Use transaction SU53 only
